correctness.rationale: Lax split semantics yields exact selector cover. Induction on r extracts finite noncoverable subteams from arbitrary teams, without assuming compactness. For an inclusion-minimal finite bad U, selectors for each deletion give a nonzero-diagonal evaluation matrix of multilinear polynomials after injective rational relabeling. Their 2^r-dimensional ambient space bounds |U|. Every binary cube is minimally bad, hence the level is exact. The package verifier tests 66332 finite team masks and rational coefficient ranks through r=4; tests support but do not establish the unrestricted theorem.

originality.rationale: The full inspected Fröhlich–Kolaitis–Meier paper (DOI:10.4230/LIPIcs.CSL.2026.10), Corollary 23, covers exactly the r=2 two-constancy instance and explicitly studies only two disjuncts in Sections 4–5. The asserted all-r sharp exact threshold for r>=3 is not implied by that restricted theorem. The later Barlag et al. abstract states an equivalence of FO definability and existence of some coherence level, not its exact exponential value. Genuine published-record and literature searches included selector/Helly/polynomial aliases and did not locate an equivalent. The inaccessible later full text and possible older combinatorial repackaging remain risks.

value.rationale: The sharp unbounded exponential locality scale 2^r for a natural r-ary family provides a complete finite-obstruction threshold, supports fixed-r first-order model checks, and proves a canonical extremal obstruction. This is qualitatively distinct from the existing fixed two-atom computation or a mere unknown-size k-existence claim. It does not rely on unsupported downstream theorems.
